title: Survival as a Barbarian — Prologue
style: 2D-animated manhwa. Motion path between keyframes. Spoken audio via <d> only.
prompt_rules: English double quotes mean ON-SCREEN glyphs. Never put novel narration in quotes.
Speech uses (S1) and <d>[English] line</d>. Voiceover must say lips remain closed.
FL2VA: both pictures belong to Shot 1; describe the BODY+CAMERA path, not two stills.
At most one short on-screen string per clip, held still for several seconds, spelled exactly.
BAN default: no subtitles, captions, bubbles, HUD words, Korean SFX.
global_audio_rules: Narration is heard, not read. (S1) is the tired young man, dry close-mic English.
chain: Each clip last generated frame feeds the next first_frame. Concatenate with ffmpeg.
